page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmare Bonnie?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Nightmare Bonnie has almost an identical appearance to his core series counterpart, but he is smaller, glossier and has less damage to his body. A large tear appears on his chest with several rips and tears all around his arms and legs. He has two segments of ears, unlike his core series character, who has three. His right hand and left foot fur are no longer exposed, and his wiry whiskers are gone. He also seems to lack the huge hole that appears on the right side of his face, but rather on the left, and appears smaller.

{| class="article-table" style="width: 55%;" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1"

Nightmare Bonnie is a solid character to use. He has Rainy Day 2, which can not only lower the enemies' defenses, but also inflict solid damage on enemies. Combined with his Bite 2 and Pizza Wheel 2, he can do huge damage to groups of enemies with their defenses dropped.
